## Hardware & Embedded Systems Services

- [PCB Design & Prototyping](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/pcb-design): Multi-layer schematic, high-speed routing, impedance matching, fabrication files (Gerber/BOM/Pick-and-Place), and prototype guidance.
- [Embedded Systems & Firmware](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/embedded-systems): Microcontroller firmware (STM32, ESP32, Arduino, ARM Cortex), FreeRTOS development, driver development, sensor integration, and low-power optimization.
- [Electronics Product Design](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/product-design): Turnkey electronic product engineering from concept to enclosure design, thermal analysis, and production assembly support.
- [End-to-End PCB Development](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/end-to-end-pcb): Testing, validation, signal integrity checks, and small-batch production support.
- [Hardware Consulting](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/hardware/consulting): Design reviews, component sourcing advice, and architecture optimization.

## Custom Software & Web Development Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/custom-software): Tailor-made ERP systems, CRM portals, internal tools, and automated business platforms.
- [Web Development & E-Commerce](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/web-development): Fast web platforms, static/dynamic sites, lead-generation portals, and e-commerce stores.
- [Mobile App Development](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/mobile-apps): Android & iOS mobile applications with backend API integration.
- [Business Intelligence & Dashboards](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/software/business-intelligence): High-throughput telemetry, real-time data portals, and analytics dashboards.

## Workshops, Training & DIY Kits

- [Embedded Systems Bootcamps](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/embedded-training): Hands-on training on STM32, ESP32, C programming, and IoT.
- [Hardware & PCB Courses](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/hardware-courses): Circuit simulation, KiCad PCB layout, and manufacturing readiness.
- [Software Development Programs](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/software-programs): Web, mobile, and full-stack software courses.
- [Corporate & College Workshops](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/workshops): Faculty Development Programs (FDPs), student bootcamps, and technical mentoring.
- [DIY Electronics Kits](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/diy-kits): Prototyping hardware, robotics kits, and STEM modules.
- [Academic Project Guidance](https://coreforgeindia.com/services/training/academic-projects): Mentorship and execution support for student and final-year engineering projects.
